title: BREAKING: Jorge Daniel Vivero Arrested on Harassment of a Public Servant Charge
excerpt: Jorge Daniel Vivero, 29, was arrested October 26, 2026, by the Laredo Police Department on a third-degree felony charge of harassment of a public servant, and booked into the Webb County Jail.
content:
BREAKING: Jorge Daniel Vivero, 29, was arrested on October 26, 2026, at 3:42 p.m. by the Laredo Police Department and booked into the Webb County Jail, according to the Webb County Sheriff's Office booking record.

Vivero is charged with harassment of a public servant, a third-degree felony, assault causing bodily injury, a Class A misdemeanor, and resisting arrest, search, or transport, a Class A misdemeanor. The charges are allegations, and Vivero is presumed innocent until proven guilty.

No bond amounts were listed in the booking record at the time of this report.

Sources: Webb County Sheriff's Office Booking Jail Search; Webb County public-access court records.

Webb Watch 956
